artworks.title: René de Gas [recto]
artworks.medium: graphite on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Collection of Mr. and Mrs. Paul Mellon
artworks.description: The sketch shows a young person from the waist up in a three-quarter view facing to the viewer's left. They have short hair, defined facial features, and are wearing a coat with a bow tie. One hand rests on a surface, and the other appears to hold the garment's belt. The background has intricate patterns that could be wallpaper or a framed artwork, suggesting a domestic setting.

artworks.title: Studies of Feet [verso]
artworks.medium: graphite on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Collection of Mr. and Mrs. Paul Mellon
artworks.description: The image shows parts of a person's body, focusing on two feet. The foot on the left appears to be partially covered by clothing near the ankle area, and its sole and toes are visible. On the right side, another foot is depicted in profile, showing the arch and toes drawn from the side view. The background is a plain, textured surface, appearing like a neutral drawing paper. There are no additional clothing, jewelry, or objects seen within the frame, and the background remains unobtrusive, serving only to highlight the drawn feet.

artworks.title: Woman Embroidering
artworks.medium: black chalk and graphite heightened with white on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Collection of Mr. and Mrs. Paul Mellon
artworks.description: The image shows a woman seated and looking at an object she holds in her hands. She is wearing a lace cap, a long-sleeved garment with gathered cuffs, and a tie at the neckline. The background is a dark, textured tone.

artworks.title: Hortense Valpinçon
artworks.medium: pastel and graphite on wove paper; laid down
artworks.creditLine: Collection of Mr. and Mrs. Paul Mellon
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait drawing of a woman's head and neck in profile view. The woman faces to the left, revealing her facial features: a defined nose and chin, with a subtle expression on her lips. Her dark hair is tied back in a bun. There are no visible clothes or jewelry. The background is plain. The artist's signature "Degas" is at the bottom left corner of the drawing.

artworks.title: Woman Reading a Book
artworks.medium: charcoal and black chalk with stumping and erasing, heightened with white chalk, on blue wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Collection of Mr. and Mrs. Paul Mellon
artworks.description: The drawing displays a person seated in a side profile, holding a piece of paper close to their chest. The individual's head is turned to the side, revealing a soft facial profile and short hair. Their attire includes a long skirt, a fitted top, a coat with fluffy cuffs, and simple, flat shoes. The background is plain. The image is rendered in shades of grey, creating a classic, timeless feel.

artworks.title: Study for "Mary Cassatt at the Louvre" [recto]
artworks.medium: graphite with blind stylus on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Collection of Mr. and Mrs. Paul Mellon
artworks.description: The image features a sketch of two women on a sheet of paper. The woman on the left is shown standing with her back to the viewer, wearing a long coat and a hat. The woman on the right is seated, facing the left, with curly hair and dressed in a long garment. The sketch is framed by geometric lines, with minimal background, and it is signed "Degas" in red in the lower left corner.

artworks.title: Study for "Mary Cassatt at the Louvre" [verso]
artworks.medium: carbon and softground wax transfer on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Collection of Mr. and Mrs. Paul Mellon
artworks.description: The image shows a sketch with two figures: a seated woman holding a book, and a standing figure with a walking cane.

artworks.title: Flowers
artworks.medium: watercolor, gouache, and black chalk, over charcoal on light brown wove paper; laid down
artworks.creditLine: Collection of Mr. and Mrs. Paul Mellon
artworks.description: This painting shows a bouquet of flowers in a gray vase. The flowers vary in color, including dark purple, pink, white, and yellow. The vase is centered, with some flowers extending upward and some leaning to the sides. Between the flowers are dark green leaves and stems. The background is beige with an area of lightly-painted pale gray on the left.

artworks.title: Young Woman Seated at a Piano [recto]
artworks.medium: black chalk on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Collection of Mr. and Mrs. Paul Mellon
artworks.description: The image is a sketch depicting the upper three-quarters of a person seated in profile, facing slightly away from the viewer. The individual appears to be sitting at a table or desk. The outline of the face is visible without detailed facial features, and the person seems to have their hair styled in a bun. The clothing appears to be modest, possibly a long-sleeved dress or top, with the contour lines suggesting folds and layers. The person is interacting with an undefined object on the table in front of them. The background is minimal, with a faint outline of vertical or horizontal elements that suggest objects in a room.

artworks.title: Young Woman Seated at a Piano [verso]
artworks.medium: black chalk on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Collection of Mr. and Mrs. Paul Mellon
artworks.description: The image is a sketch of a person's upper body seen from the back sitting on a chair in a side profile position. The person has their head turned slightly to the right. Their hair is covered with a headscarf or cap. They are wearing a long-sleeve outfit, possibly a jacket, with a defined waistline. The person's arms are resting on a surface in front of them, suggesting they are seated at a desk or table. The background is plain and neutral, typical of sketch paper, with no additional objects or details visible.

artworks.title: Postcard with Two Peasants Digging
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink on a postcard
artworks.creditLine: Collection of Mr. and Mrs. Paul Mellon
artworks.description: This drawing is a sketch of two people working in a field. The people are bent over with their backs to us. The person on the left appears to wear a dress, while the person on the right wears a jacket with trousers and a hat. The landscape around them is drawn in simple lines, showing some trees and a small house in the distance. Outside of the sketch, most of the paper is taken up by several lines of handwritten text, with a signature on the bottom left.

artworks.title: Harlequin
artworks.medium: graphite on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Collection of Mr. and Mrs. Paul Mellon
artworks.description: The image shows a sketch of a person in full body. The figure is standing with one leg slightly bent and one arm bent across the chest while the other hangs by their side. The person's face is partially detailed with an elongated shape, defined lips, and a prominent nose. The hair is abstractly depicted, and they wear a hat with a curved brim. The clothing consists of a fitted outfit with a diamond pattern and detailed sections on the sleeve. The figure seems to be holding or resting a long stick against the shoulder with one hand. The background includes lightly sketched abstract lines and shading, with no specific details provided regarding location or setting.

artworks.title: View of the Dome of Saint Peter's, Rome
artworks.medium: watercolor over graphite on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Collection of Mr. and Mrs. Paul Mellon
artworks.description: The image shows a view from beneath a canopy of trees towards an architectural structure partially obscured by foliage. The horizon is at the top with details of a classical building visible at the center-left. The brushstrokes are loose and fluid, especially in the treatment of leaves and colors. The painting has an impressionistic style, capturing light and shadow through the trees. The color palette consists of muted greens, browns, grays, and blues creating a serene atmosphere. A distant dome adds depth to the scene. The sky is painted in soft blues and grays, enhancing the calm natural setting in the artwork.

artworks.title: A Farmer and a Sheep Crossing a Rustic Bridge
artworks.medium: red chalk on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Collection of Mr. and Mrs. Paul Mellon
artworks.description: The image shows a pastoral scene from an elevated point of view. The horizon is depicted by a faint line of distant trees and hills merging with the sky. In the center, a figure is riding an animal across a rustic bridge over a stream. Tall trees frame the scene, with delicate branches reaching upwards in a canopy. Birds are faintly visible in the sky. The brushstroke style is intricate and delicate, with fine lines composing the trees and foliage. The color palette is monochromatic, dominated by sepia tones.

artworks.title: Edgar Degas
artworks.medium: graphite on paperboard
artworks.creditLine: Collection of Mr. and Mrs. Paul Mellon
artworks.description: The image shows a man in a side view sketch, standing with hands clasped behind his back, holding a piece of fabric. He has a beard, mustache, and medium-length hair, wearing a jacket and trousers. A detailed top hat is placed on a stool to his left. Another figure with a top hat and cane is seen behind, looking at framed artwork on a wall. The background is neutral, resembling a simple room or gallery with art and furniture.

artworks.title: Dance in the Country
artworks.medium: pen and brush and gray ink on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Collection of Mr. and Mrs. Paul Mellon

artworks.title: Self-Portrait
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink on brown wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Collection of Mr. and Mrs. Paul Mellon
artworks.description: This drawing depicts a man from the waist up, seated in a forward-facing position. The man has prominent facial features, including a strong nose and thick eyebrows. His hair is medium in length and slightly wavy, with a full beard and mustache. He is wearing a jacket over a shirt. The drawing is done in ink on a brown-toned paper. The background is plain. The artwork is framed by a simple outline, and there's a signature in the lower right corner of the drawing, with the name "H. Rousseau" inscribed below the image on the paper.

artworks.title: Rue de Rivoli and Pavillon Marsan
artworks.medium: watercolor over graphite on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Collection of Mr. and Mrs. Paul Mellon
artworks.description: The image shows a street scene of a town square with various classic European buildings, trees, and people in period clothing engaged in activities. A grand building with steep, dark roof and chimneys stands out on the horizon. The painting is detailed with precise brushstrokes and features a warm color palette of ochres, blues, and greens.

artworks.title: Mary Cassatt at the Louvre: The Etruscan Gallery
artworks.medium: soft-ground etching and drypoint on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Collection of Mr. and Mrs. Paul Mellon
artworks.description: The image shows two individuals. The person on the left is seated and holding a book. They wear an overcoat and a necklace. The person on the right stands with an umbrella in their right hand. They have curly hair and wear a fitted jacket with a long skirt. Both figures wear formal attire. The background is simple.

artworks.title: Virginie Being Admired While the Marquis Cavalcanti Looks On
artworks.medium: monotype (black ink) touched with pastel on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Collection of Mr. and Mrs. Paul Mellon

artworks.medium: lithograph in black on wove paper; laid down
artworks.dimensions:
image: 15.6 x 12.6 cm (6 1/8 x 4 15/16 in.)
plate (lithograph stone): 22.3 x 15.9 cm (8 3/4 x 6 1/4 in.)
sheet: 34.6 x 27.7 cm (13 5/8 x 10 7/8 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Collection of Mr. and Mrs. Paul Mellon
artworks.description: The image shows a head and shoulders portrait of a person. The individual is mostly in profile with their head turned slightly towards the viewer. The facial features include a strong nose, distinct lips, and a highlighted broad forehead. The hair is brushed back and covers the ears partially. The person wears a dark, high-collared garment. The background is a textured, dark surface, contrasting with the lighter portions of the face. The style of the image is reminiscent of pointillism, with intricate dot patterns creating shading and form.

artworks.title: Child with Sword, Turned to the Left (L'Enfant à l'épée, tourné à gauche)
artworks.medium: etching and aquatint in black on japan paper
artworks.creditLine: Collection of Mr. and Mrs. Paul Mellon
artworks.description: The image shows a young boy standing with a slight turn in his posture. He has wide-open eyes, a small mouth, short, neatly styled hair, and is dressed in a formal outfit consisting of a dark jacket, knee-length pants, dark shoes, a large white collar, and a sash around his neck and body. He is holding a stick or cane with one hand. The background is plain with shaded areas and textured lines suggesting a subtle pattern or shadowing effect.

artworks.title: Berthe Morisot
artworks.medium: lithograph on chine collé on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Collection of Mr. and Mrs. Paul Mellon
artworks.description: The image shows a bust portrait of a woman. She is depicted facing slightly to the right with her head turned towards the viewer. She has dark eyes, softly drawn facial features, and dark hair styled loosely. She wears a large hat with a bow or ribbon, a dark outfit with a high collar, and possibly layers of clothing. The background is plain and light, emphasizing the subject.

artworks.title: Fashionable People at Les Ambassadeurs (Aux Ambassadeurs: Gens Chic)
artworks.medium: oil à l'essence over black chalk on wove paper, mounted on cardboard
artworks.creditLine: Collection of Mr. and Mrs. Paul Mellon
artworks.description: A man and woman sit across from each other at a small, narrow café table under a porch-like roof in this vertical drawing on tan paper. The people’s skin is the color of the paper, and their clothing and hints of the surrounding are painted with streaks and thin washes of vivid color. Closer to us and to the left, the woman sits in a chair with an arched back. Her face is mostly angled away from us, but she has a delicate nose, and her lips appear to be closed. Her pale turquoise-blue dress has a high neck, a tight bodice, a long skirt, and long sleeves puffed along the upper arm. A black hat with short sprays like a spurting fountain is tucked into her yellow updo. Across from her, the man also has yellow hair. His eyes are almost slits under thin brows, and his small lips are closed and possibly pursed under a thin mustache. He has a square chin and prominent jawline. He wears a black tie and dinner jacket with a white flower tucked into the buttonhole. His shirt and the tablecloth are the tan of the paper. A decanter of a yellow liquid, presumably wine, sits on the table. A gray fenced at elbow height for the seated couple runs across the back of the space. The view under the overhanging roof is cobalt blue with tree canopies shaded turquoise green. A store window across a black street shows a mannequin wearing a pink dress. The scene is loosely sketched and details fade beyond the main couple. The artist signed the lower left corner with his initials, HTL, conjoined in a circle.
